content: As Ṣāʾin al-Dīn states, he wrote the commentary at the request of friends, first in Arabic and then translating it into Persian for ease of comprehension; its theoretical introduction has one main section (aṣl) and fourteen subsections (vaṣl).
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, Sharḥ-i Naẓm al-Durr, preface
